q-163337.name: Question 6
q-163337.problem: A dumbbell in a gym has a mass of $1\,\text{kg}.$ What is this mass in grams?
q-163337.worked_solution:
A table showing the units of mass in metric units is given below.

$$

$$

| Name | Symbol | Conversion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Kilogram | $\text{kg}$ | $1\,\text{kg}=1\,000\,\text{g}$ |
| Gram | $\text{g}$ | Base Unit |
| Milligram | $\text{mg}$ | $1\,000\,\text{mg}=1\,\text{g}$ |

$$

$$

So, $1\,\text{kg}$ is equivalent to $1\,000\,\text{g}.$
